### Marketplace Bahasa (101 bahasa)

| Bahasa | Logo | Warna |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Python | Simple Icons | #3776ab |
| Rust | Simple Icons | #dea584 |
| Go | Simple Icons | #00add8 |

| Java/Java (clike) | VS Code Icons | #659ad2 |
